messages:
kyle (SRE): pd-bot triggered: High GPU queue growth in us-west-2 - > 60m sustained. Paging on-call.
pd-bot: Incident created (INC-2026-042). Severity: P1. Affected service: inference-serving-usw2. Trigger: queue_size > 1200 and error_rate spikes. Pager: kyle (SRE).
kyle (SRE): seeing lots of preemptible GPU term events around 18:10 UTC, autoscaler attempted adds but hit max_pools limit and failed to fallback to reserved pool. Queue is backlogged, clients hitting 429s and timeouts. Customer-impacting. Elena, please inform support.
elena (Support): opening customer threads now. Notifying top 5 customers on Dedicated trial. They report elevated latencies and a few 502s. I'll post updates to support-runbook channel.
jordan (Infra): looking at autoscaler logs. Found this:
```
2026-03-14T18:09:57Z autoscaler INFO scaleup request for pool=spot-usw2-gpu count=24
2026-03-14T18:10:03Z cloud-provider ERROR request failed: insufficient capacity
2026-03-14T18:10:04Z autoscaler WARN fallback to reserved policy=true
2026-03-14T18:10:04Z autoscaler ERROR reserved pool attach failed: quota-exceeded
```
jordan (Infra): cloud provider returned InsufficientCapacity. Our reserved pool quota for the org is fully used by other tenants. The fallback path attempted to create nodes in reserved but quota blocks it.
maria (ML): model-serving pods are accumulating KV cache; each warmup takes long. Also a lot of small requests creating overhead. Can we enable prefix caching eviction to reduce memory churn as temporary mitigation?
kyle (SRE): immediate mitigation proposal:
1) Flip routing policy for production route 'text-gen' to prefer regional fallback in us-east-1 (lower latency penalty) for new requests.
2) Reduce concurrency per replica to reduce OOM risk but accept throughput drop.
3) Temporarily disable spot-only pools for this customer tier and route their traffic to existing reserved nodes in us-east-1.
4) Request quota bump with cloud provider and raise max_pools in autoscaler config.
Can infra run 1 and 3 now? :thumbsup:
jordan (Infra): starting with 1 and 3.
- Routing change command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --route text-gen --policy region-prefer --regions us-east-1,us-west-2 --weight 0.7:0.3
```
applied. Traffic shift in progress, should be ~70% to us-east within 90s.
kyle (SRE): 2) reduce concurrency on model-service config:
```
kubectl -n serving set env deploy/model-runtime MAX_CONCURRENCY=4
```
applied to canary first. Observing.
jordan (Infra): 3) disabled spot-only pool for prod-tier by changing pool selector. Also attached an emergency reserved instance from our owned-reserved pool in us-east-1 to handle burst. NOTE: requires careful token routing changes, but done.
deploy-bot: Route update deployed to control plane. Version: 2026.3.14-evac1.
maria (ML): enabling prefix cache eviction and reducing kv_cache_size to 0.6x on canary;
```
PATCH /v1/configs/model-runtime
{ "kv_cache_ratio": 0.6, "prefix_eviction": true }
```
applied.
elena (Support): customers pinged: "Received elevated latency 18:08-18:30 UTC, degradation reduced after 18:16, thanks" — one customer still seeing intermittent timeouts.
kyle (SRE): monitoring queue size and 429 rate. queue_size graph: decreased from 1350 -> 420 within 6 minutes after routing change. 429 rate down from 12% to 1.5%.
jordan (Infra): autoscaler logs show repeated retries to provision spot pools earlier. After routing shift and reserved attach, new nodes active in us-east; however autoscaler still failing to scale in us-west due to provider transient quota errors. I've kicked off a manual scale for us-west reserved fallback (force create) with ticket to cloud support.
pd-bot: kyle acknowledged the incident. On-call handoff scheduled at 18:30 UTC to maria (ML) for next hour.
kyle (SRE): quick note for postmortem: root cause appears to be correlated spot preemptions in us-west-2, autoscaler attempted to add more spot pools but hit both cloud insufficient capacity and our internal max_pools guardrail. The fallback logic attempted reserved but failed due to quota being exhausted by cross-tenant usage. Need to verify quota accounting and fallback ordering.
maria (ML): taking over on-call. I'll keep monitoring model quality signals and failure rates, and coordinate with infra for longer-term scale changes.
elena (Support): writing customer-facing summary:
"We experienced degraded inference performance in us-west-2 starting at 18:08 UTC on 2026-03-14 due to GPU pool pressure from spot instance interruptions. We routed traffic to alternate region and attached reserved capacity; services recovered by 18:16 UTC for most customers. Engineering continues to investigate root cause and mitigation plan."
kyle (SRE): temporary mitigations we've performed (for postmortem):
- Rerouted production traffic to us-east-1
- Attached emergency reserved nodes to owned reserved pool
- Lowered per-replica concurrency and enabled prefix eviction
- Manual autoscaler trigger and cloud support ticket created
We should aim to: increase reserved fallback capacity for critical tenants, adjust autoscaler to favour reserved fallback earlier, and add preemption-aware capacity buffer.
jordan (Infra): filed cloud support ticket: CS-15489 with provider for InsufficientCapacity events and quota review. Also filed infra ticket INF-2026-042 to raise max_pools and add billing alert when reserved pool utilization > 80%.
maria (ML): I'll own follow-ups on runtime knobs: make prefix eviction the default under memory pressure, improve warm-start behavior, and create a lighter weight cold-start mode for small requests.
elena (Support): customers updated. One enterprise account requested timeline for full fix; assigned to solutions-eng for follow-up.
pd-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 moved to status: mitigated. Severity downgraded to P2 at 18:28 UTC.
kyle (SRE): handing off to maria. I'll remain available for escalations.
maria (ML): acknowledged. Handoff notes posted to /incidents/INC-2026-042. Next steps: verify quota accounting, adjust autoscaler fallback ordering, add canary for routing policy changes, and write runbook entry for spot mass-preempt scenario.
-- 18:30 UTC handoff complete --
